## 1. System Overview

Two distinct loading mechanisms operate in parallel at session start:

- **Hook-injected (global tier):** `~/.claude/memory/` holds cross-project user facts. `load-global-memory.sh` fires on the first `UserPromptSubmit` and emits the index plus all linked topical files as a `systemMessage`. This is the only mechanism that loads the global tier; the harness does not touch it natively.
- **Harness-native (project tier):** `~/.claude/projects/<project-key>/memory/MEMORY.md` is loaded automatically by Claude Code for the active working directory. No hook is involved. The harness follows markdown links to topical files.

Compaction introduces a third mechanism: `pre-compact.sh` snapshots session state into a handoff file before context is compressed, and `post-compact.sh` re-injects that snapshot afterward so task continuity is not lost.

---

## 2. Session Lifecycle

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
    actor U as User
    participant H as Claude Code Harness
    participant SBR as surface-behavioral-rules.sh
    participant GLM as load-global-memory.sh
    participant EBR as extract-behavioral-rules.sh

    Note over H: Session start / first prompt
    U->>H: Submit first prompt
    H->>SBR: UserPromptSubmit (session_id, cwd, prompt)
    SBR->>SBR: Check /tmp/claude-session-id.behavioral-loaded
    SBR->>EBR: Invoke extract-behavioral-rules.sh
    EBR->>EBR: grep H2 headings from behavioral.md
    EBR-->>SBR: Numbered rules (7 lines)
    SBR-->>H: systemMessage (behavioral imperatives)
    SBR->>SBR: Write /tmp/claude-session-id.behavioral-loaded

    H->>GLM: UserPromptSubmit
    GLM->>GLM: Check /tmp/claude-session-id.global-loaded
    GLM->>GLM: Read ~/.claude/memory/MEMORY.md
    GLM->>GLM: Parse markdown links, read each topical file
    GLM-->>H: systemMessage (global memory tier)
    GLM->>GLM: Write /tmp/claude-session-id.global-loaded

    H->>H: Load project MEMORY.md natively (no hook)
    H-->>U: Context fully assembled

    Note over H: Subsequent prompts (same session)
    U->>H: Submit prompt
    H->>SBR: UserPromptSubmit
    SBR->>SBR: Marker exists, exit 0 (silent)
    H->>GLM: UserPromptSubmit
    GLM->>GLM: Marker exists, exit 0 (silent)
```

---

## 3. Hook Inventory

### 3.1 `load-global-memory.sh`

**Trigger:** `UserPromptSubmit` (no matcher, fires on every prompt until marker is set)
**Registered in:** `settings.json` under `UserPromptSubmit[3]`
**Source:** `claude/hooks/load-global-memory.sh` (symlinked to `~/.claude/hooks/`)

Injects the global memory tier once per session. The session marker (`/tmp/`) prevents re-injection on every subsequent prompt. Path traversal on linked files is guarded: resolved target must stay under `~/.claude/memory/`.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    A([UserPromptSubmit fires]) --> B{jq present?}
    B -->|no| Z([exit 0, silent])
    B -->|yes| C{MEMORY.md exists?}
    C -->|no| Z
    C -->|yes| D{session_id matches\na-zA-Z0-9._-?}
    D -->|no| Z
    D -->|yes| E{/tmp/...global-loaded\nexists?}
    E -->|yes| Z
    E -->|no| F[touch /tmp/...global-loaded]
    F --> G[Read MEMORY.md verbatim]
    G --> H[grep markdown links\nfrom index]
    H --> I{link resolves under\n~/.claude/memory/?}
    I -->|no| J[skip, guard triggered]
    I -->|yes| K[Read linked topical file]
    K --> H
    J --> L[Build PAYLOAD string]
    K --> L
    L --> M[jq: emit systemMessage JSON]
    M --> N([exit 0])
```

**Reads:**
- `~/.claude/memory/MEMORY.md`
- `~/.claude/memory/<file>.md` for each `([file.md])` link in the index

**Writes:**
- `/tmp/claude-session-<session_id>.global-loaded` (existence marker)
- stdout: `{"systemMessage": "..."}`

---

### 3.2 `surface-behavioral-rules.sh`

**Trigger:** `UserPromptSubmit` (no matcher)
**Registered in:** `settings.json` under `UserPromptSubmit[0]` (fires before `load-global-memory`)
**Source:** `claude/hooks/surface-behavioral-rules.sh`

Extracts the 7 numbered imperatives from `behavioral.md` and emits them as a `systemMessage`. Delegates extraction to `extract-behavioral-rules.sh` so the hook stays in sync when the rules file changes. On extraction failure, emits a visible warning rather than silently injecting nothing.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    A([UserPromptSubmit fires]) --> B{jq present?}
    B -->|no| Z([exit 0, silent])
    B -->|yes| C{session_id valid?}
    C -->|no| Z
    C -->|yes| D{/tmp/...behavioral-loaded\nexists?}
    D -->|yes| Z
    D -->|no| E[touch /tmp/...behavioral-loaded]
    E --> F[Invoke extract-behavioral-rules.sh]
    F --> G{Rules extracted?}
    G -->|yes| H[Build rules payload]
    G -->|no| I[Build LOAD ERROR payload]
    H --> J[jq: emit systemMessage JSON]
    I --> J
    J --> K([exit 0])
```

**Reads:** delegates to `extract-behavioral-rules.sh`
**Writes:**
- `/tmp/claude-session-<session_id>.behavioral-loaded`
- stdout: `{"systemMessage": "..."}`

---

### 3.3 `pre-compact.sh`

**Trigger:** `PreCompact` (matcher: `*`, fires on both `/compact` and auto-compact)
**Registered in:** `settings.json` under `PreCompact[0]`
**Source:** `claude/hooks/pre-compact.sh`

Snapshots everything needed to restore task continuity after compression: file activity (parsed from the session transcript JSONL), git branch/status/log/diff. Enforces a rolling cap of 5 handoffs per project by deleting the oldest on overflow. Also migrates any legacy flat handoffs (pre-Phase-9 layout) into the `handoffs/` subdirectory as a side effect.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    A([PreCompact fires]) --> B{jq present?}
    B -->|no| Z([exit 0, skip])
    B -->|yes| C[Parse: trigger, session_id,\ncwd, transcript_path]
    C --> D{cwd present?}
    D -->|no| Z
    D -->|yes| E["Derive project key:\necho CWD | tr '/.' '-'"]
    E --> F["mkdir -p\nhandoffs/"]
    F --> G{transcript_path\nin hook input?}
    G -->|yes| H[Use transcript_path directly]
    G -->|no| I["Fallback: derive from session_id\nor find most recent .jsonl"]
    H --> J["jq: select Read/Write/Edit tool_use\nfrom assistant messages"]
    I --> J
    J --> K["git -C cwd:\nbranch, status --short,\nlog --oneline -5, diff --stat"]
    K --> L["Write handoffs/handoff_\nFILE_TS_SID8.md\n(YAML front matter + sections)"]
    L --> M{"count of handoff_*.md\n> 5?"}
    M -->|yes| N["Delete oldest\nby filename sort\n(not mtime)"]
    M -->|no| O
    N --> O["Migrate flat legacy\nhandoff_*.md\nfrom MEMORY_DIR root"]
    O --> P([exit 0])
```

**Reads:**
- Hook input JSON (stdin)
- `~/.claude/projects/<key>/<session_id>.jsonl` (or most recent `.jsonl`)
- `git` state from `$CWD`

**Writes:**
- `~/.claude/projects/<key>/memory/handoffs/handoff_<FILE_TS>_<SID8>.md`
- Deletes overflow handoffs (oldest by filename sort)
- Moves legacy flat handoffs into `handoffs/` (migration)

**Handoff filename:** `handoff_YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MMZ_<first8chars-session-id>.md`

**Handoff format:**
```
---
name: Session handoff <FILE_TS>
description: Pre-compact snapshot, <trigger> trigger, branch <BRANCH>
type: project
---

**Trigger / Session / Branch / Project / Timestamp**

## Files active this session
## Git state
## Recent commits
## Files changed (git diff)
```

---

### 3.4 `post-compact.sh`

**Trigger:** `PostCompact` (matcher: `*`)
**Registered in:** `settings.json` under `PostCompact[0]`
**Source:** `claude/hooks/post-compact.sh`

Re-injects the most recent handoff as a `systemMessage` immediately after context compression completes. Prevents Claude from re-reading files or re-exploring state that was already established. Falls back to the flat memory layout for projects not yet migrated to Phase-9.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    A([PostCompact fires]) --> B{jq present?}
    B -->|no| Z([exit 0, silent])
    B -->|yes| C[Parse cwd from input]
    C --> D{cwd present?}
    D -->|no| Z
    D -->|yes| E["Derive project key:\necho CWD | tr '/.' '-'"]
    E --> F["find handoffs/ -name\nhandoff_*.md | sort -r | head -1"]
    F --> G{Found in handoffs/?}
    G -->|no| H["Fallback: find memory/ root\nfor flat handoff_*.md"]
    H --> I{Found in flat layout?}
    I -->|no| Z
    I -->|yes| J[Read handoff content]
    G -->|yes| J
    J --> K["jq: emit systemMessage with\n'## Restored from pre-compact handoff'\nheader + content"]
    K --> L([exit 0])
```

**Reads:** most recent `handoff_*.md` from `handoffs/` (or flat fallback)
**Writes:** stdout: `{"systemMessage": "## Restored from pre-compact handoff\n\n..."}`

---

## 4. File Inventory

| File | Location | Format | Written by | Read by |
|------|----------|--------|------------|---------|
| Global index | `~/.claude/memory/MEMORY.md` | Markdown, `[Title](file.md)` links | User / Claude (auto-memory) | `load-global-memory.sh` |
| Global topical | `~/.claude/memory/<name>.md` | YAML frontmatter + markdown | User / Claude, `migrate-memory.sh`, `seed-memory.sh` | `load-global-memory.sh` |
| Project index | `~/.claude/projects/<key>/memory/MEMORY.md` | Markdown, `[Title](file.md)` links | User / Claude, `seed-memory.sh`, `migrate-memory.sh` (strips stale entries) | Harness natively |
| Project topical | `~/.claude/projects/<key>/memory/<name>.md` | YAML frontmatter + markdown | User / Claude, `seed-memory.sh` | Harness natively, `memory-doctor.sh` |
| Handoff | `~/.claude/projects/<key>/memory/handoffs/handoff_<ts>_<sid8>.md` | YAML frontmatter + markdown sections | `pre-compact.sh` | `post-compact.sh` |
| Global marker | `/tmp/claude-session-<id>.global-loaded` | Empty file | `load-global-memory.sh` | `load-global-memory.sh` (existence check) |
| Behavioral marker | `/tmp/claude-session-<id>.behavioral-loaded` | Empty file | `surface-behavioral-rules.sh` | `surface-behavioral-rules.sh` (existence check) |
| Behavioral rules | `claude/rules/behavioral.md` | Markdown, H2 numbered headings | User (source of truth) | `extract-behavioral-rules.sh` |

### Frontmatter schema (topical files)

Every topical file (global and project) except `MEMORY.md` requires these three fields:

```yaml
---
name: <short-kebab-case-slug>
description: <one-line summary>
type: <user | feedback | project | reference>
---
```

`memory-doctor.sh` check B validates this across all tiers.

## 6. Session Marker Pattern

The global and behavioral hooks each use a `/tmp/` marker file to enforce first-prompt-only injection. This prevents re-emitting the same `systemMessage` on every prompt in a session.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A[Hook fires] --> B{Marker file\nexists in /tmp/?}
    B -->|yes| C([exit 0, no output])
    B -->|no| D[touch marker]
    D --> E[Build and emit systemMessage]
    E --> F([exit 0])
```

**Marker paths:**

| Hook | Marker |
|------|--------|
| `load-global-memory.sh` | `/tmp/claude-session-<session_id>.global-loaded` |
| `surface-behavioral-rules.sh` | `/tmp/claude-session-<session_id>.behavioral-loaded` |

**Session ID validation:** both hooks reject session IDs that contain characters outside `[a-zA-Z0-9._-]` before constructing the marker path. This prevents marker path traversal if the harness ever passes a malformed session ID.

**Lifecycle:** markers are created when the hook first fires and persist until the OS clears `/tmp/` or `cleanup-sessions.py` runs. `cleanup-sessions.py` is a standalone script (not hooked); it removes stale markers for expired sessions.

---

## 7. Compaction Pipeline

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
    actor U as User / Auto
    participant H as Harness
    participant PRE as pre-compact.sh
    participant TR as Transcript JSONL
    participant GIT as git
    participant HD as handoffs/
    participant COMP as Compaction Engine
    participant POST as post-compact.sh

    U->>H: /compact or context threshold (80-85%)
    H->>PRE: PreCompact event\n(trigger, session_id, cwd, transcript_path)
    PRE->>TR: jq: extract Read/Write/Edit tool_use\nfrom assistant messages
    TR-->>PRE: file activity list (up to 60 lines, sort -u)
    PRE->>GIT: git -C cwd branch/status/log/diff
    GIT-->>PRE: branch, status, 5 recent commits, diff stat
    PRE->>HD: Write handoff_FILE_TS_SID8.md
    PRE->>HD: Count handoff_*.md
    alt count > 5
        PRE->>HD: Delete oldest by filename sort
    end
    PRE->>PRE: Move flat legacy handoffs into handoffs/
    PRE-->>H: exit 0 (never blocks)

    H->>COMP: Compress context window
    COMP-->>H: Compaction complete

    H->>POST: PostCompact event (cwd)
    POST->>HD: find handoff_*.md | sort -r | head -1
    alt found in handoffs/
        POST->>POST: Read handoff content
    else not found
        POST->>POST: Fallback: find in memory/ root
    end
    POST-->>H: systemMessage\n("## Restored from pre-compact handoff")
```

**Rolling cap implementation detail:** `pre-compact.sh` sorts handoff filenames lexicographically (not by mtime) with `sort | head -n $OVERFLOW`. Because the filename encodes a minute-precision UTC timestamp (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MMZ`), lexicographic sort is equivalent to chronological sort. The oldest (lexicographically smallest) are deleted first.

**Transcript fallback chain:**

1. `transcript_path` from hook input (provided directly by Claude Code)
2. `~/.claude/projects/<key>/<session_id>.jsonl`
3. Most recent `.jsonl` in the project directory (sorted by mtime via Python one-liner)

---

## 8. Harness Native Load

Claude Code loads the project `MEMORY.md` automatically for the active `cwd` at session start. This is built into the harness and requires no hook.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    A([Session start]) --> B["Harness resolves project key\nfrom cwd: tr '/' '-', tr '.' '-'"]
    B --> C{~/.claude/projects/key/\nmemory/MEMORY.md\nexists?}
    C -->|no| D([No project memory loaded])
    C -->|yes| E[Read MEMORY.md]
    E --> F[Parse markdown links\n[Title](file.md)]
    F --> G{Linked file exists?}
    G -->|yes| H[Read topical file into context]
    G -->|no| I[Skip missing link]
    H --> F
    I --> F
    F --> J([Project tier in context])
```

**Key distinction from the hook-injected global tier:**

| Property | Global tier | Project tier |
|----------|-------------|--------------|
| Load mechanism | `load-global-memory.sh` hook | Harness native |
| Trigger | First `UserPromptSubmit` | Session start |
| Scope | Cross-project, machine-level | Per working directory |
| Location | `~/.claude/memory/` | `~/.claude/projects/<key>/memory/` |
| Index file | `MEMORY.md` (loaded by hook) | `MEMORY.md` (loaded by harness) |
| Controllable per-session | Yes (hook can be modified/disabled) | No (harness behavior) |

The project tier is loaded before any hook fires. The global tier arrives via `systemMessage` after the first prompt is submitted.

---

## Appendix: Supporting Scripts

### `extract-behavioral-rules.sh`

Called exclusively by `surface-behavioral-rules.sh`. Resolves its own path via `realpath "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"` to navigate through symlink layers (`~/.claude/scripts/` is a symlink into the dotfiles repo). Greps `behavioral.md` for `^## [0-9]+\. ` headings and strips the `## ` prefix. Exits 1 if the file is missing or contains no numbered headings.

### `memory-doctor.sh`

Diagnostic tool; not hooked. Synthetically exercises checks A through G:

| Check | What it verifies |
|-------|-----------------|
| A | Global memory directory and `MEMORY.md` exist |
| B | Every topical file has `name`, `description`, `type` frontmatter |
| C | Every project `handoffs/` subdir is at or under cap of 5 |
| D | No flat `handoff_*.md` files remain outside `handoffs/` |
| E | `load-global-memory.sh` emits on first call, silent on second |
| F | `pre-compact.sh` writes into `handoffs/` subdir |
| G | `post-compact.sh` reads from `handoffs/` subdir first |

Run: `bash ~/.claude/scripts/memory-doctor.sh`

### `migrate-memory.sh`

One-shot, idempotent. Transforms the pre-Phase-9 layout into Phase-9:

1. Promotes user-level files (`user_*.md`, `feedback_jq_*.md`, `feedback_memory_workflow*.md`, `feedback_agent_token_cost*.md`) from all project tiers into `~/.claude/memory/`. Conflict resolution: newer mtime wins.
2. Moves flat `handoff_*.md` files from each project `memory/` root into `memory/handoffs/`.
3. Strips stale MEMORY.md index entries: removes lines pointing at promoted files and at session handoff entries.

Run: `bash ~/.claude/scripts/migrate-memory.sh [--dry-run]`

### `seed-memory.sh`

Initializes memory on a new machine from templates in `claude/memory-templates/`. Never overwrites existing files (tops up missing ones only). Creates `handoffs/` subdir under the project memory dir. Path encoding: `${PROJECT_PATH//\//-}` (replaces `/` with `-`).

Templates:
- `claude/memory-templates/*.md` (project tier)
- `claude/memory-templates/global/*.md` (global tier)
